Flotilla.name: Salvage Flotilla
Flotilla.lore: Riverboat superstructures and paddlewheels bolted onto wrecked starship hulls.

Concord.name: Aurelian Concord
Concord.lore: A luxury zeppelin navy rebuilt from chrome ocean-liner starships.

Directorate.name: Atomic Directorate
Directorate.lore: Finned rocket ships; every lift ring orbits a glowing reactor.

Syndicate.name: Iron Syndicate
Syndicate.lore: Armored warships of a militarist world: rivets, props and black exhaust.

Commons.name: Sunward Commons
Commons.lore: Garden-grown eco-starships flying on solar-sail wings.

Brood.name: Verdant Brood
Brood.lore: Living bio-starships regrown into flying creatures.
